column1: # The grammar and the server this engine's committed answers come from.
# default is the grammar compat.tsv (dynamodb/parser) is judged by. DynamoDB
# has no grammar of its own and no server CI can start, so default is no
# image: it is the grammar of the PartiQL reference implementation,
# partiql-lang-kotlin, at the commit of the release in the source tag
# (partiql-parser/src/main/antlr). The digest is the SHA-256 of
# testdata/PartiQLParser.g4 followed by testdata/PartiQLTokens.g4, which are
# v0.14.9 is the last release of the grammar that holds every statement
# DynamoDB documents. The v1 grammar (v1.6.1 on 2026-11-13) was rewritten
# along SQL's EBNF and no longer derives INSERT INTO t VALUE {...}, an
# driver records the tapes and nothing else: DynamoDB Local, Amazon's own
# local endpoint for the service, at the release whose answers they hold. It
# does not judge compat.tsv: it runs a PartiQL subset, so it cannot judge the
# statements omni must accept beyond it.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
